description: This PHP source file defines the class 'PartialClaimAttachment' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\\Claim\\Dto'. It represents a data transfer object (DTO) used to encapsulate information about attachments related to claim requests in the OrangeHRM system. The class includes properties for attachment details such as ID, size, description, filename, file type, added by, and attached date, along with methods to access and modify these properties. It also uses several traits for additional functionality like date formatting and entity referencing.

classes.name: PartialClaimAttachment
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing an attachment to a partial claim request, including properties for attachment details, associated employee information, and methods for property access and modification.
